messages:
marina: FYI opened PR to refresh the model-catalog card for Aurora variants. Main goals: clarify supported runtimes, add a migration checklist for customers moving from aurora-7b -> aurora-7b-quant, and swap the old quant guide link. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4892
aj: Nice. Can you include the perf delta we're seeing when the kernel selector isn't enabled? Wanted to be explicit so folks know when to expect slower tokens/sec on edge devices.
sanjay: Also add an explicit note about the routing fallback semantics: when a pinned variant can't be scheduled we route to the compatible variant in the same family and emit event code MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK in the audit log. That saved a customer from 504s last week.
marina: good — I'll add the event code and an example log line.
leo: For the SDK snippet, let's show three small examples: pinned model, family pin (e.g., aurora-7b@stable -> any compatible), and no-pin. Quick sample: 
```
# pin to exact version
client.generate(model="aurora-7b@2025-11-02", prompt="...")
# pin to family stable (allow compatible variants)
client.generate(model="aurora-7b@stable", prompt="...")
# unpinned (platform may upgrade)
client.generate(model="aurora-7b", prompt="...")
```
marina: thanks, I'll add that. aj, can you paste the microbench numbers so I can put a small table in the card? We want to show p4d fp16 vs quant path numbers.
aj: P4d fp16 pinned aurora-7b: 730 toks/s. aurora-7b-quant coldstart path: 610 toks/s. When kernel selector enabled on runtime 3.2 quant path reaches ~700 toks/s. I'll attach CSV to the PR.
sanjay: Runtime compatibility: runtime 3.1 -> full support for aurora-7b (fp16) but "limited" for aurora-7b-quant-v2 (missing custom attention). runtime 3.2 -> full support for both; include a short matrix row and link to runtime release notes.
leo: Found a stale link to docs/old-quant.md in the card. We should point to docs/quantization/overview.md and add a redirect. I'll open a tiny redirect PR after this.
marina: assign follow-ups: aj — bench CSV + raw logs; leo — snippet PR + redirect; sanjay — one-liner runtime compatibility text; I'll update PR body + card content by EOD and request reviews.
aj: I'll upload CSV in 30m.
leo: Redirect PR after lunch.
sanjay: Dropping the compatibility blurb into the PR now.
docs-bot: PR #4892 opened by marina: docs/model-catalog: aurora variants card refresh + migration checklist (labels: docs, model-catalog)
marina: One styling question: do we want the migration checklist under the "Usage" section or as a separate "Migration" subsection? I feel separate is easier to find.
leo: Separate "Migration" subsection please. UX will thank us.
aj: tiny suggestion: in the benchmark table add a note about measurement conditions (batch size=1, seq=512). Helps reproducibility.
marina: will add metrics note. Also adding a small example of a fallback policy JSON for customers who want to prefer lower-latency variants.
sanjay: Example fallback policy text looks good. Minor wording tweak: change "may fall back" -> "will fall back" when pinned variant is unschedulable. Clarity > hedging.
marina: updated. ping me for sign-off once CI passes.
aj: LGTM after numbers are attached.
leo: +1
sanjay: +1
marina: merging after one approval + CI then. thanks :rocket:
